cards.title: Prediction of Drug Transporter-Mediated Disposition, Tissue Concentration, and Drug-Drug Interaction.
cards.what: Drug transporters play a crucial role in drug elimination and tissue distribution. This chapter focuses particularly on the liver, which expresses clinically important transporters, summarizing the latest findings on appropriate experimental tools, methodologies, and strategies for quantitatively understanding/predicting transporter-mediated drug distribution and elimination.

molecule.name: baxdrostat
molecule.atc_source: WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology

mechanisms.text: Baxdrostat is an inhibitor of human aldosterone synthase. Aldosterone contributes to hypertension by promoting the retention of sodium and water by the kidneys, which increases blood volume and, consequently, raises blood pressure. Aldosterone can cause vascular dysfunction, inflammation, and fibrosis.
